subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: When a ready draft is prepared, the system shall preserve valid Argus content-bound trailers across rebase, compile the contract against current mainline, publish the exact prepared head with a lease, update the same selected-host PR, and request the configured human's review of that head; for installed Forgejo, require that human's latest authenticated exact-head approval before authorizing a lock under P-9's trusted-repository model; retain existing GitHub approval and protection behavior.
fit_criterion: Source/rebased bindings validate; digest equals stored texts; PR head equals prepared SHA; reviewer differs from agent; Forgejo preparation does not require proof of privileged/direct/force-push or path-exemption enforcement; unapproved, stale, agent-approved, rejected, changed-head or uncertain-review lock attempts produce zero lock-tag writes; valid configured-human approval plus verified merged contents permits the lock; existing GitHub checks pass.
